We know very well who Mr. Bolsonaro is. We know that he is nothing more than an agent, a puppet, a mere figurehead entirely controlled by the U.S.A.
We know that the U.S.A. today behaves with unprecedented violence, behaving like an empire that wants to dominate all peoples and the entire planet.
An empire that, since its founding, has always pursued an aggressive, militaristic, imperialist policy, not only toward its closest neighbors, but also toward the entire world whenever anyone resists it.
That is why the defeat of Mr. Bolsonaro is necessary, because it will be felt across the entire planet as the defeat of the empire, and Lula's victory as the victory of the people.

French Presidential Candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon on Brazil's Lula:
Lula is for all of us here in France, as in the rest of the world, a name, a face, and a political commitment that is well known and appreciated by the greatest number of people.
Well known and appreciated by the poor, the humiliated, the exploited, and workers who are mistreated and underpaid.
For a long time now, Lula has, in a way, been our hero.

The speed limits on Starlink and Starshield are still there. The speed has not been restored. 
And the delivery of interceptors to protect us against Russian ballistic missiles is still delayed.
This is a real problem, because the Russians attack us almost every single day.

Zelensky:
I really want our relations – between Ukraine and America, and with all our other partners – to be strong, truly friendly, and without misunderstandings. 
These days, people ask why Ukraine is speaking more openly and directly to the world. The answer is simple. 
We want others to understand us – societies, nations, as many people as possible. 
When people understand what is really going on, political leaders can take a stronger path – the one that can really bring peace closer. 
And peace is what we want more than anything.
